architecture.selected: Amortized sweep of entirely empty fixed blocks. Keep live locations and removed escaped locations stable; never reuse removed addresses. Index pointer identity defines membership, even if current value undefined. Clear retired names and dead next links, not detached values. Keep nonnil index/materialized comparison state.
architecture.threshold: Saturating uint32 removal counter; after outer traversal or nonactive remove, sweep at min(roundUp(liveDynamicNames+16,16),MaxUint32). Fast return for active traversal or fewer16retirements. Count removals since sweep, not total holes, avoiding repeated unproductive scans of sparse live blocks.
architecture.bound: At sweep every retained block contains a live index entry, at most16entries perblock. Between sweeps a live+16 threshold rounded up adds at most15 further retired entries. Bound applies after outer traversal finishes; a callback may temporarily retain its active chain until return. Empty table retains at most15retired entries between sweeps. Existing Go map capacity can retain its live high-water allocation; not claimed to shrink.
architecture.iteration: Saved/restored bool guards each and direct hash comparison across nested callbacks and panic; only outermost exit can reclaim. No cursor list or per-entry owner/previous pointer.
architecture.rollback: Move capacity/retired with dynamic chain; keep original wrapper iterating state. Detached cleanup wrapper stays protected so its exit cannot unlink an outer cursor chain.
architecture.capacity: One-byte maximum block capacity hint, capped16, avoids restarting geometric growth after full sweep. No slot recycling.
rejected: Per-entry block owner plus block prev/live metadata adds storage to all dynamic properties; amortized scan needs none.
Moving/compacting live entries or reusing removed slots invalidates escaped pointers.
Unlinking during each or direct compare misses reentrant appended rows and invalidates cursors.
Full scan every remove or threshold based on total holes can repeatedly rescan sparse live blocks.
Immediate clearing on every zero-live remove allocates a block per cycle instead of batching.
Bit packing materialized/iteration/capacity and narrowing counter changes all consumers and complicates behavior; readable fields chosen with measured Go386 cost.
no_extra_cost_improvements: Metadata fits existing Goarm64 padding, keeping table64B and entry/block layouts unchanged.
16-entry aligned threshold avoids anchor1 churn discarding almost-empty blocks: unaligned screening165B/op -> accepted88B/op. No new state.
Inline begin/end helpers and ordinary retired<16 fast path avoid scanning/threshold arithmetic when no reclamation is due.
